metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the best exercises to do in the morning for instant sciatica pain relief. 

When it comes to sciatica, one of worst times of the day is first thing in the morning, especially while trying to get out of bed. 

These exercises are going to help with that by quickly reducing tension and pressure on the whole sciatic nerve pathway, giving instant relief and less pain throughout the day. 

As an added bonus, all of the exercises can be done in bed.
